# EU DPP Provider — Complete Architectural & Compliance Specification

## 1. Executive Summary
EU DPP Provider (https://eudppprovider.com) provides enterprise-grade compliance software and sovereign data vault infrastructure for manufacturers, pack assemblers, and automotive OEMs subject to the European Union's Battery Regulation (Regulation EU 2023/1542) and Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR, Regulation EU 2024/1781).

## 2. Regulatory Framework & Definitive Deadlines
- **20 July 2026**: DG GROW Central DPP Registry operational (`registry.product-passport.ec.europa.eu`).
- **18 August 2026**: A–E Carbon Footprint performance class labeling applicable to EV batteries.
- **18 February 2027**: Mandatory Digital Battery Passport enforcement under Articles 77 & 78.
- **18 August 2027**: Supply chain due diligence policies and third-party audit verification under Regulation (EU) 2025/1561.
- **18 February 2028**: Maximum lifecycle carbon footprint thresholds enforced for EV batteries.
- **18 August 2028**: Mandatory recycled content documentation declarations (Cobalt, Lithium, Nickel, Lead).
- **18 August 2031**: Mandatory recycled content minimum percentage targets enforced (Cobalt 16%, Lead 85%, Lithium 6%, Nickel 6%).

## 3. Commercial Engagement Models
- **Model A · Managed Sovereign Cloud Subscription (SaaS)**: Turnkey 10-year hosting in Frankfurt ISO/IEC 27001 data vault, 99.9% uptime SLA, automated rolling regulatory patches, ZKP trade secret shielding, and worldwide GS1 Digital Link 2D resolution.
- **Model B · Enterprise On-Premise Turnkey Suite**: Private cloud / corporate datacenter deployment, read-only connectors to plant MES, ERP (SAP/Oracle), and Cloud BMS, historical data cleansing, and staff commissioning.
- **Model C · Early Adopter Pilot Program**: 1–3 battery pack models pre-validation in Frankfurt sandbox.

## 4. Technical Architecture & Data Security
- **Data Boundary**: Customer retains 100% intellectual property ownership of internal formulations and supplier pricing.
- **ZKP Verification**: Cryptographic proofs allow conformity validation without raw chemical disclosure.
- **eIDAS 2.0 Compliance**: PAdES Baseline electronic seals issued by qualified trust service providers on the EU Trust List.
- **Harmonized Standards**: EN 18220:2026 (2D Barcode Data Carriers) & EN 18219:2026 (Unique Product Identifiers).
- **Resolver**: High-speed GS1 Digital Link resolution (<50ms global DNS).
